factual_methodology.summary: RBNZ institutional histories and monetary-policy handbook establish the legal design and target evolution; RBNZ and Stats NZ historical CPI and labour data support the quantitative visuals.

novelty.summary: Adds the founding modern inflation-targeting case to the policy-case series, distinguishing institutional credibility from the broader disinflation already underway and documenting the later move toward flexibility.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Public prose states facts and mechanisms directly, separates observed evidence from inference, includes explicit limitations and contains no internal publication-process narration.

contextual_depth.summary: Separates target design, operational independence, accountability, observed disinflation, unemployment and transfer limits rather than attributing the full macro outcome to one law.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Required visual budget and EN/PT-BR visual parity were checked; quantitative visuals use compatible units and structural visuals encode mechanisms defended in prose.

contrary_evidence: Inflation was already declining before the 1989 Act, so the legal reform is not treated as a clean causal experiment.
The unemployment increase occurred amid broad structural reforms and recession and is not attributed solely to inflation targeting.
limitations: Inflation was already declining before the 1989 Act, so the legal reform is not treated as a clean causal experiment.
The unemployment increase occurred amid broad structural reforms and recession and is not attributed solely to inflation targeting.
New Zealand's institutional capacity limits direct transfer to economies facing fiscal dominance or weaker policy credibility.
notes: Approved in the 7 October deep editorial refresh after source, bilingual, taxonomy and visual checks.

en.title: New Zealand inflation targeting: credibility through an explicit target, operational independence and later flexibility
en.deck: New Zealand's pioneering inflation-targeting regime combined a public numerical objective, operational central-bank independence and accountability, then became more flexible after credibility was established.
en.regime: Institutional monetary stabilization through an explicit public inflation target, operational independence and accountability, followed by gradual transition toward flexible inflation targeting.
en.key_risk: Copying the target without fiscal consistency, operational capacity and credible accountability can reproduce the form of inflation targeting without the mechanism that anchored expectations.
watch: Evolution from strict to flexible targets

pt-BR.title: Metas de inflação na Nova Zelândia: credibilidade por meta explícita, independência operacional e flexibilidade posterior
pt-BR.deck: O regime pioneiro da Nova Zelândia combinou objetivo numérico público, independência operacional do banco central e prestação de contas, tornando-se mais flexível após a construção de credibilidade.
pt-BR.regime: Estabilização monetária institucional por meta pública explícita, independência operacional e prestação de contas, seguida por transição gradual para metas flexíveis.
pt-BR.key_risk: Copiar a meta sem consistência fiscal, capacidade operacional e prestação de contas crível pode reproduzir a forma sem o mecanismo que ancorou expectativas.
watch: Evolução de metas rígidas para flexíveis
